controls.name: JWT Bearer Authentication & Session Integrity
controls.description: Rejects unauthenticated, expired, or tampered bearer tokens with HTTP 401.
controls.failure_behavior: Fails closed with RFC 7807 problem detail error payload.

controls.name: Role-Based Mutation Guardrails
controls.description: Restricts privileged operations (scavenging, benchmarks, governance) to ADMIN/SECURITY_LEAD.
controls.failure_behavior: Returns HTTP 403 Forbidden without executing privileged side-effects.

controls.name: Assessment Scope Preflight Enforcement
controls.description: Validates target inclusion against legal proof of authorization prior to job dispatch.
controls.failure_behavior: Transitions job to REJECTED with immutable audit log event.

controls.name: Exclusions Absolute Precedence
controls.description: Explicit scope exclusions strictly override broader CIDR or domain inclusions.
controls.failure_behavior: Blocks assessment dispatch with OUT_OF_SCOPE error.

controls.name: Cryptographic Evidence Digest & Provenance
controls.description: Computes immutable SHA-256 byte digest and Merkle proof for all scanner artifacts.
controls.failure_behavior: Flags evidence as TAMPERED and invalidates dependent downstream findings.

controls.name: Tamper-Evident Audit Hash Chaining
controls.description: Enforces monotonic sequencing and SHA-256 predecessor hash chaining across audit ledger.
controls.failure_behavior: Raises AuditChainBrokenException and halts recovery drills.

controls.name: Remediation Separation of Duties
controls.description: Requires distinct reviewer approval before remediation scripts or playbooks can execute.
controls.failure_behavior: Prevents remediation execution; status remains REMEDIATION_PROPOSED.

controls.name: Independent Remediation Retesting
controls.description: Requires genuine re-execution against target; prevents recycling original evidence.
controls.failure_behavior: Marks finding REOPENED if vulnerability is re-observed.

controls.name: Isolated Disaster Recovery Verification
controls.description: Restores database to isolated sandbox and runs foreign-key and page integrity audits.
controls.failure_behavior: Aborts live recovery; rolls back to last-known-good backup.

controls.name: Outbound SSRF & Metadata Protection
controls.description: Blocks loopback (127.0.0.1/8), private RFC 1918 CIDRs, and cloud metadata (169.254.169.254).
controls.failure_behavior: Raises SSRFSecurityError and returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.

controls.name: Release Provenance & Cryptographic Signature
controls.description: Verifies HMAC-SHA256 manifest signature and file hashes; detects unmanifested files.
controls.failure_behavior: Fails release gate; rejects deployment archive.

controls.name: Workload Isolation & Backpressure Enforcement
controls.description: Caps concurrent worker execution; returns HTTP 429 backpressure when saturated.
controls.failure_behavior: Raises WorkloadSaturatedError and defers or rejects task.

controls.name: Token Revocation & Immediate Session Invalidation
controls.description: Immediately rejects JWT tokens issued prior to user password change or global logout.
controls.failure_behavior: Raises HTTP 401 Unauthorized for revoked session tokens.

controls.name: Multi-Tenant Object-Level Boundary & Project Isolation
controls.description: Strictly prevents users in Project A from accessing findings, assets, or targets in Project B.
controls.failure_behavior: Returns HTTP 403 Forbidden without leaking cross-tenant data.

controls.name: Anti-Expansion Guard for Discovery Observations
controls.description: Disallowed automatic scope expansion; newly discovered targets routed to proposal inbox.
controls.failure_behavior: Diverts unauthorized discovery to AssetInclusionProposal inbox; blocks active scanning.

controls.name: Authenticated Symmetric Encryption at Rest & Key Rotation
controls.description: Encrypts external connector credentials with Fernet AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 envelope.
controls.failure_behavior: Rejects plaintext access and fails closed on corrupted encryption envelope.

controls.name: Path Traversal & Unsafe Input Sanitization
controls.description: Rejects relative path traversal sequences ('../'), absolute paths, and oversized payloads.
controls.failure_behavior: Raises PathTraversalSecurityError or HTTP 400 Bad Request.

controls.name: Job Concurrency, Idempotency & Lease Protection
controls.description: Guarantees that identical assessment dispatches do not create duplicate running jobs.
controls.failure_behavior: Deduplicates in-flight jobs or returns HTTP 409 Conflict.
